translations.web: House and riches are an inheritance from fathers, but a prudent wife is from Yahweh.
translations.bsb: Houses and wealth are inherited from fathers, but a prudent wife is from the LORD.
translations.kjv: House and riches are the inheritance of fathers: and a prudent wife is from the LORD.
translations.asv: House and riches are an inheritance from fathers; But a prudent wife is from Jehovah.
